svg.title: P17: Verify-on-stop guards
svg.desc: Analytical UML class view of the proposed pattern contract; not an observed implementation or execution trace.
svg.text: Primitive / UML CLASS VIEW / ANALYTICAL MODEL

text.tspan: Check artifacts before accepting completion.

svg.text: dashed arrow: call dependency · brown: return/failure · analytical, not an observed trace

text.tspan: The agent proposes completion after producing an artifact.
A stop or finish action is requested.
Exit interception, verifier execution, and accept-or-continue result.
The stop is accepted only after the verifier reports sufficient evidence.
Stop can be intercepted and at least one verification is available.
Failed verification returns actionable feedback or blocks completion.
The same acceptance gate cannot be bypassed by another stop path.
Unavailable or flaky verifier yields explicit unknown or failure, not silent
success.
1 Agent → CompletionProposal propose(stop)
2 CompletionProposal → AcceptanceGate request(verification)
3 AcceptanceGate → Verifier verify(artifact)
4 Verifier → Artifact inspect(claims)
5 Artifact ↩ Verifier return(evidence)
6 Verifier → AcceptanceGate decide(verdict)
7 AcceptanceGate ↩ Agent continue_or_accept()
Project test commands, acceptance hooks, verifier agents, and blocking policies.
Test pass, fail-and-continue, verifier error, repeated stop, and bypass route.
Tests run by the user after the run are not verify-on-stop.
